_meta.law: IP-001 generic typed slots, our words; every numeric {TOKEN} declared in params; every noun {TOKEN} declared in sites. Placement: template-defined structures (objective-raid caches, strike's four structures, flank's emplacements) keep their template rules; any {SITE} token an objective introduces — on ANY template — is placed within 4 hexes of the map center before deployment (the defender places it if any defender objective references it, otherwise the GM), and is a destructible medium building (CF 40) unless an objective says otherwise; if BOTH sides' objectives reference a {SITE}, the GM places it at the map-center hex. Counting: 'half your force' always means half the units you deployed, by count; a crippled unit that exits counts toward an exit objective unless the objective says 'non-crippled'; at emit time the generator clamps unit-referencing count params ({N}/{K}, except strike's structure counts, which keep their declared min/max) to half the scale's nominal side size (Scale 1 = 4 units, 2 = 8, 3 = 12); fixed emplacements and structures are never units and never count toward 'your force' or any unit-count objective. Commander: each side publicly names one deployed unit as its commander before deployment; any objective naming 'the enemy commander's unit' refers to that unit. Scale: turn and radius params assume a Scale-1 standard track map; hexes convert at 1 hex = 2 inches at ground scale; the GENERATOR bakes the Scale-2+ conversion at emit ({R} doubled, {T}/{T2} +1) — the printed numbers are final. Placement and commander conventions are RENDERED onto each emitted track (deployment text); this law block is the designer contract, not a table-facing surface.
